summary: HF0 is active and publicly describes an application-based, in-person San Francisco residency for ambitious technical founders, with $1M investment via uncapped SAFE and a 5% equity fee. The public site/apply page did not expose a current application deadline or next cohort dates, so this should remain reviewable rather than a dated current event.
